evidence: decorative_mascot: Data holds the same arms-out standing pose in hook@0.3, seg1:mid, seg2:end, seg3:start and seg4:mid — only rescaled and re-parked on the bar tip; no setup->action->payoff bit is ever tied to a number.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:mid (t=11.71s) and seg1:end (t=16.30s) show a 1px horizontal 2007-2025 axis at ~45% height with one label ($1,000B / 2025) and a tiny mascot straddling it; everything below the axis is bare gradient, and the narration's other two figures (589B, 806B) are never drawn.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene renders a single-point timeline sized for a wide frame into a 9:16 canvas, so the viz occupies one thin band and the three-value growth story collapses to one plotted marker.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Rebuild seg1 as a full-height demonstration of the growth: plot all three years (589B -> 806B -> 1T) as elements that grow/stack down the frame, filling the lower two thirds, with the mascot performing one act against the rising value instead of perching on the axis.
